notes: Gear that drops on the white belt tier. Stat lists are per rarity: [common, uncommon, rare, epic]. Charms have a small effect instead of stats (effect types are in packages/sim/src/effects.ts). C7 (drafts): items for tiers 2-10 added per S2; ids keep S2's <belt>-<slot>-<n> placeholders; every item has a tier. Charm amounts set in R-BAL-14 (drafts/planning/R-BAL-14-charm-amounts.md). Kind Stone amounts are the extra share (game multiplier = 1 + amount). Feather amounts are extra COUNTER ticks. Great Lamp 1 = full DASH recharge.
